ambiguities.description: It is unclear whether every student must have a grade for every offering they enroll in, or whether grading is optional until the semester ends. The transcript says 'at the end of a semester, a student receives a letter grade' which suggests mandatory grading eventually, but at any given point in time some enrolled students may not yet have a grade. Should the grade role be mandatory or optional relative to enrollment?

source_references.excerpt: At the end of a semester, a student receives a letter grade for each course offering they were enrolled in.

ambiguities.description: The relationship between 'Student enrolls in CourseOffering' and 'Student receives LetterGrade for CourseOffering' seems to imply a subset constraint (a student can only receive a grade for an offering they were enrolled in). Should this be formalized as a subset constraint?
